"""Read-only F50 source admission observation; caller persists the returned data."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path


def observe(repository, source, kernel_obj, core_status, toolchain):
    """Check fixed source authorities and the unchanged native core, without building."""
    import native_provider_inputs as admission
    from native_hp_build import toolchain_paths

    def canonical_hash(value):
        raw = json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode()
        return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()

    repository = Path(repository)
    if repository.resolve(strict=True) != repository or repository != admission.REPOSITORY:
        raise ValueError('source-owned admission module/repository identity differs')
    source, obj, core_path = (Path(value).resolve(strict=True)
                              for value in (source, kernel_obj, core_status))
    tools = toolchain_paths(Path(toolchain))
    worker_path = repository / admission.WORKER_CONTRACT_PATH
    worker_digest = admission.reviewed_contract_sha256(worker_path, repository)
    worker = admission.load_contract(worker_path, repository)
    worker_bindings = admission.repository_inputs(repository, worker)
    required = admission.worker_input_policy(worker, worker_digest)
    generation = admission.verify_worker_generation(repository, worker, worker_bindings,
                                                    worker_digest)
    roots = admission.selected_inputs(worker, repository, source,
        repository / worker['provider_root'], worker['units'], [])
    expected_roots = [repository / relative for relative in
        ('compat/native-runtime/worker-f49/include', 'compat/native-runtime/include')]
    expected_roots += [source / relative for relative in
        ('sys/external/bsd/common/include', 'sys/external/bsd/drm2/include')]
    proofs = sorted(name for name, row in worker['repository_inputs'].items()
                    if row['role'] == 'generation_proof_owner')
    if (len(worker_bindings) != 17 or len(required) != 8 or len(proofs) != 9 or
            set(required) & set(proofs) or set(required) | set(proofs) !=
            set(worker['repository_inputs']) or roots != expected_roots or
            generation['state'] != 'VERIFIED_WORKER_SOURCE_GENERATION_ONLY' or
            generation['operation_count'] != 27):
        raise ValueError('exact Worker source admission result differs')
    core = admission.verify_core(core_path, worker, source, obj, tools)
    worker_headers = admission.provider_header_policy(core, worker, worker_digest)
    worker_fragments = admission.task_fragment_policy(worker, worker_digest)
    worker_task_inputs = admission.task_worker_input_policy(worker, worker_digest)
    if worker_headers or worker_fragments or worker_task_inputs:
        raise ValueError('Worker acquired FILE or Task-owner requirements')

    selections = (
        ('file-f33', admission.CONTRACT_PATH, admission.CONTRACT_SHA256),
        ('anon-f35', admission.ANON_CONTRACT_PATH, admission.ANON_CONTRACT_SHA256),
        ('file-f37', admission.FILE_CONTRACT_PATH, admission.FILE_CONTRACT_SHA256),
        ('task-f39', admission.TASK_CONTRACT_PATH, admission.TASK_CONTRACT_SHA256),
        ('task-worker-f41', admission.TASK_WORKER_CONTRACT_PATH,
         admission.TASK_WORKER_CONTRACT_SHA256),
        ('wait-f44', admission.WAIT_CONTRACT_PATH, admission.WAIT_CONTRACT_SHA256),
        ('poll-f46', admission.POLL_CONTRACT_PATH, admission.POLL_CONTRACT_SHA256))
    previous = {}
    for label, relative, digest in selections:
        path = repository / relative
        if admission.reviewed_contract_sha256(path, repository) != digest:
            raise ValueError('previous fixed contract selection differs: ' + label)
        contract = admission.load_contract(path, repository)
        bindings = admission.repository_inputs(repository, contract)
        selected = admission.selected_inputs(contract, repository, source,
            repository / contract['provider_root'], contract['units'], [])
        if (contract['core_status_sha256'] != worker['core_status_sha256'] or
                admission.worker_input_policy(contract, digest) or
                admission.verify_worker_generation(repository, contract, bindings, digest)):
            raise ValueError('previous profile acquired Worker admission: ' + label)
        headers = admission.provider_header_policy(core, contract, digest)
        fragments = admission.task_fragment_policy(contract, digest)
        task_inputs = admission.task_worker_input_policy(contract, digest)
        poll_inputs, wait_inputs, poll_generation, wait_generation = [], [], {}, {}
        if digest == admission.POLL_CONTRACT_SHA256:
            poll_inputs = admission.poll_input_policy(contract, digest)
            poll_generation = admission.verify_poll_generation(repository, contract,
                                                               bindings, digest)
        else:
            if admission.poll_input_policy(contract, digest):
                raise ValueError('previous profile acquired Poll admission: ' + label)
            wait_inputs = admission.wait_input_policy(contract, digest)
            wait_generation = admission.verify_wait_generation(repository, contract,
                                                               bindings, digest)
        previous[label] = dict(state='PASS_UNCHANGED_REVIEWED_PROFILE',
            contract=relative, contract_sha256=digest,
            repository_commit=contract['repository_commit'],
            repository_input_count=len(bindings), repository_bindings_sha256=canonical_hash(bindings),
            units=list(contract['units']), include_roots=list(map(str, selected)),
            required_patched_headers=headers, required_task_fragments=fragments,
            required_task_worker_inputs=task_inputs, required_wait_inputs=wait_inputs,
            required_poll_inputs=poll_inputs, wait_generation_proof=wait_generation,
            poll_generation_proof=poll_generation)

    core_summary = dict(state='PASS_UNCHANGED_FULL_F32_CORE',
        core_status=str(core_path), core_status_sha256=worker['core_status_sha256'],
        netbsd_pin=core['netbsd_pin'], object_count=len(core['objects']),
        object_sha256={name: row['sha256'] for name, row in core['objects'].items()},
        configured_makefile_sha256=core['configured_makefile_sha256'],
        prior_kernel_sha256=core['prior_kernel_sha256'],
        native_tool_sha256=dict(core['native_tool_sha256']),
        prior_artifact_count=len(core['prior_artifacts']),
        generated_configuration_count=len(core['generated_configuration_sha256']),
        declared_generated_configuration_count=len(core['declared_generated_configuration_inputs']),
        source_provenance_mode=core['source_provenance']['mode'],
        archive_sha256=core['source_provenance']['archive_sha256'],
        verified_core_archive_member_count=len(core['source_provenance']['verified_source_members']))
    return dict(state='PASS_READ_ONLY_WORKER_PROVIDER_ADMISSION',
        contract=admission.WORKER_CONTRACT_PATH, contract_sha256=worker_digest,
        repository_commit=worker['repository_commit'], repository_input_count=17,
        required_input_count=8, proof_only_count=9, required_inputs=required,
        proof_only_inputs=proofs, repository_inputs=worker_bindings,
        generation_proof=generation, include_roots=list(map(str, roots)),
        required_patched_headers=worker_headers, required_task_fragments=worker_fragments,
        required_task_worker_inputs=worker_task_inputs, unchanged_profile_count=len(previous),
        unchanged_profiles=previous, core=core_summary,
        native_preprocessing='NOT_RUN', native_compilation='NOT_RUN',
        producer_execution='NOT_RUN', historical_recipe_execution='NOT_RUN',
        builder_cli_execution='NOT_RUN', full_kernel='NOT_RUN', linked=False,
        installed=False, booted=False, runtime='NOT_RUN')
